provenance: Small, manually curated baseline; advisory context only. English episode subtitles are authoritative. NOT a claim to have reviewed every episode or Internet lore.

recurring_people.name: Stan Smith
recurring_people.guide: Father in Smith family; CIA agent; often overconfident, forceful and ridiculous.

recurring_people.name: Francine Smith
recurring_people.guide: Stan's wife; direct, funny, sometimes impulsive. Avoid defaulting to stiff/formal Japanese.

recurring_people.name: Hayley Smith
recurring_people.guide: Stan and Francine's adult daughter; outspoken and often skeptical of Stan.

recurring_people.name: Steve Smith
recurring_people.guide: Stan and Francine's teenage son; often awkward, sensitive and enthusiastic.

recurring_people.name: Roger
recurring_people.guide: Alien living with the Smiths; frequently uses costumes, aliases, personalities and different voices. NEVER automatically replace his episode-specific alias with 'Roger'.

recurring_people.name: Klaus
recurring_people.guide: Talking goldfish with a human personality; typically dry, needy or absurd.

recurring_people.name: Toshi
recurring_people.guide: One of Steve's friends; may speak Japanese depending on scene.

translation_policy: Translate the actual English dialogue into naturally spoken Japanese for an adult comedy.
Preserve jokes, insults, profanity, sexuality, sarcasm and deliberately crude humor without sanitizing or adding harsher content.
Prioritize conveying a punchline or intent over literal word correspondence; concise localization is welcome.
Never invent an identity, narrator, context, or relationship for a line based solely on this series bible.
Do not apply a standard character voice to an unidentified speaker. Roger's alias and persona may vary within an episode.
Do not translate show-specific names as generic nouns when the episode clearly uses them as names.
If episode dialogue conflicts with this background, always follow the episode.
Translate only the requested current cue; nearby prior and future English lines are context, not additional output.
